adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review replaced the framework placeholder with source-supported XML/PDF activity rows, matched DBAASP row adjudication, and a bounded final review. The paper is publication-grade with cautions because local supplementary files are landing HTML duplicates and mechanism claims remain structure-activity context rather than direct mechanism.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Local supplementary_original files are repeated Nature article landing HTML files, not structured spreadsheets or PDF supplements; main XML/PDF tables carry the activity/toxicity values needed for worker-2.
The primary source reports peptoid compound identities by figures and tables; worker-4 does not convert these peptoids into canonical amino-acid sequences.
SAXS/self-assembly and cytotoxicity evidence are retained as contextual mechanism evidence, not direct bacterial target or membrane permeabilization proof.
Database PAO1 labels are reconciled to primary-source P. aeruginosa PA01/H103 table/method labels without inventing extra strain detail.

supplementary_assets.coverage: Files are HTML landing-page captures; no structured supplementary activity spreadsheet was locally recoverable or required after XML/PDF table repair.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP assay and experiment rows were matched back to XML Tables 1 and 3 where source-supported; citation-only literature rows were verified only as article links. No database-only activity row is promoted as primary-source evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 365 row-level MIC/IC50 records were extracted from XML Tables 1-3 with units, target species/strains, method locators, and database-row links where available.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is restricted to structure-activity, SAXS self-assembly context, and HaCaT cytotoxicity/selectivity context; no direct mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking/major rework remains after source-supported activity repair and database reconciliation.
